title: GCP-6.5 step 11: 4.09 Conflict payload is the rejection map, not the winning gateway's claim
description: Residual from bead project-LICHEN-worker6-yiv0 (closed: 4.09 response code + test reconciliation landed at HEAD). spec/08:315 step 11 mandates the 4.09 payload carry the WINNING gateway's claim; resources.rs handle_post_slots win-arm (resources.rs:1955-1979) instead carries the rejection CBOR map (status/reason/conflicting_slots). STRUCTURAL BLOCKER: GatewayCoordinator (resources.rs:1122-1134) holds no signing key — responding with our own claim as COSE_Sign1 requires threading the gateway Schnorr48 keypair (or a pre-encoded claim) into the coordinator, mirroring the C claim_store_cose pattern. worker-1's round-4 comment: peer_claims only record the LOSER's claim (resources.rs:1941-1948), so no stored winning COSE exists to echo back. Also verify the GCP-6.5 step 10 contract (2.04 Changed on conflict-resolved) while in the area — the relinquish arm currently responds 2.05/success-shaped. Discovered while verifying yiv0: 252 lib tests green, 3 conflict tests assert 0x89. Out of yiv0's declared scope ('only the code constant needs changing').
close_reason: Fixed: the 4.09 slot-conflict fallback payload (win-arm, resources.rs handle_post_slots) no longer carries the legacy rejection map (spec-divergent descriptor); the win-arm now always responds spec/08:315-shaped — the recorded own COSE envelope via record_own_claim_cose fast path when present, else an empty-payload 4.09 (Rust-only fallback, commented; C always has the winner's COSE stored so there is no C behavior to mirror — the old comment's 'C parity 4.09/resp_len 0' claim was wrong per coap_slot_coord.c:1634-1656 and was corrected). Step 10 contract verified: the relinquish arm already responds 2.04 Changed (test lower_iid_peer_forces_complete_local_reallocation asserts 0x44). Tests: gateway_coordinator_slot_conflict_resolution updated to assert 0x89 + empty payload (legacy map assertions removed per spec oracle); 263 lib tests green x6 runs, fmt clean. 3x delegated codereview (kimi-k3): pass1 correctness — 2 comment-accuracy findings, fixed; pass2 security — PASS; pass3 edge — cf=0-as-0xc0 divergence filed (new P2 bead discovered-from 12gq, comment added to 12gq), stale twin comment at resources.rs:3156 fixed, end_to_end.rs:1048 RED finding verified pre-existing on baseline (stash+retest, identical failure) and tracked by this workspace's adjudication bead — evidence comment added there.
